story.title: Beyond the pills: Texas veterans search for PTSD relief
story.summary: As Texas lawmakers start filing bills for the 90th Legislative Session, a group of local veterans from the state's Veterans of Foreign Wars have laid out their legislative priorities, including alternative modalities to pharmaceutical opioids and anti-depressants.
